medium.sinkage_window: 0.1 s to 1.12 s (before the tilt reached 2 deg)

high.sinkage_window: 0.1 s to 0.76 s (before the tilt reached 2 deg)

provenance.reference_trajectory: toe_catch and friction: prescribed reference walks (gait.generate, sizing.NOMINAL and sizing.BRISK), kinematics and inverse dynamics only
provenance.servo_held: standing: every joint held at q_home by stiff position servos, no balance control
provenance.static_only: the pile floors match the sourced static stiffness only; damping is assumed and MuJoCo's contact regularisation adds inertia, so times to tip (fell_at_s) are not results and the floors are not suited to touchdown or dynamic studies or to controller training
provenance.needs_controller: walking or standing on carpet, foot pitch during swing, slip, toe-drag forces, touchdown dynamics and any stance that tips in the standing check

summary.gate: pass: the governing friction need is below the carpet band's lower edge on both walks and the swing foot clears every pile top in mid-swing with the stance sole at the 98 kPa depth.  toe_clearance_margin_mm: the least of those clearances (mm above the pile top); friction_margin: band lower edge minus the governing need, least over the walks.  The 0.06 H carpet target depends on the reference lift, which every candidate shares, and is reported in checks, not gated; the standing check is a contact-model sanity check and is not gated.
